benefits.name: Extra Minor Wound
benefits.description: You can take one more minor wound than normal.

benefits.name: Heavy Melee Damage
benefits.description: You inflict +1 damage with heavy melee weapons.

system.description:
Orcs are a proud, if aggressive, people with a sense of honor.

You gain the following characteristics:

  • You can take one more minor wound than normal.
  • You are trained in intimidation (except against other orcs).
  • You inflict +1 damage with heavy melee weapons.
